These results will be hereafter referred to as (say) ’Lacroix, from Bertrand et al. (1999)’. They have attempted a first comparison by taking several numerical methods to compute the basic configuration presented in this section. Two investigators among the five failed to predict the process and showed unrealistic behaviours in Figures 9a and 9b: Lacroix and Delannoy seem to be insufficiently converged as shown by Figure 9a, and Binet-Lacroix overestimates the average Nusselt number by more than 30% (Figure 9b). Hence, this collection of results allows us to validate our numerical method and check if realistic results are obtained for complex physical configurations.
